title: Steering Video Diffusion Transformers with Massive Activations
abstract: In this work, we study the role of Massive Activations (MAs), which are rare, high-magnitude spikes confined to a few fixed hidden dimensions in video diffusion transformers (DiTs). We uncover a structured positional hierarchy: MA magnitudes peak at first-frame tokens and recur at the spatial boundary tokens of latent frames, with this pattern being most pronounced during early denoising. We trace this organization to an encoding asymmetry of the video VAEs, whose causal temporal padding and zero spatial padding cause the first latent frame and frame borders to carry reduced content load. Elevated MAs consistently align with these lower-content structural positions. To understand their function, we analyze intermediate representations and find that MAs act as implicit rescalers of residual computation: enlarging MAs suppresses the corresponding self-attention and feed-forward updates, while erasing them amplifies these updates. Together, these observations suggest that MAs serves as a token-level rescaler of residual computation, which video DiTs deploy unevenly, placing the strongest damping at the encoding-asymmetric structural positions. Motivated by this native rescaling behavior, we propose Structured Activation Steering (STAS), a training-free technique that steers MAs at the observed structural positions toward a scaled, model-derived reference during early denoising. STAS requires no additional forward passes and consistently improves video quality and temporal coherence across text-to-video models with negligible overhead.

analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接对应 video-generation，且全文给出方法、实验、限制与 exact-version 证据闭环。
analysis.evidenceZh: 论文方法由以下流程构成：定位 video DiT 的 massive-activation dimensions -> 用 VAE padding 与 RoPE intervention 追踪其空间时间来源 -> 验证 MA 对 residual branch 的 rescaling -> 构造 model-derived structural reference -> 早期 denoising 做 training-free STAS steering。（Main method section/figure, p. 4）；作者报告 STAS 在多种 T2V backbones 上以近零额外开销一致改善 video quality/temporal coherence，并可叠加 CFG-Zero 与 FlowMo。（Main experiment/table, p. 8）；多数指标提升幅度有限且依赖 model-specific MA 维度；机制证据来自 intervention，但长期视频、不同 VAE 与极端 prompt 的稳定性仍有限。（Limitations/discussion and scope, p. 24）
analysis.caveatZh: 多数指标提升幅度有限且依赖 model-specific MA 维度；机制证据来自 intervention，但长期视频、不同 VAE 与极端 prompt 的稳定性仍有限。；多数指标提升幅度有限且依赖 model-specific MA 维度；机制证据来自 intervention，但长期视频、不同 VAE 与极端 prompt 的稳定性仍有限。 所有实验结论均只按作者报告表述。；所有实验数字均为作者报告，本项目没有独立复现。
